findings.location: content.body.meaningUk: "і (перед i-, hi-)"
findings.description: The spelling-based condition is overbroad. Initial hi- does not always represent the vowel [i]: agua y hielo retains y.
findings.suggestion: Use "і (варіант y перед голосним звуком [i])".

items.reviewerAnswer: e = and, replacing unstressed copulative y before the vowel sound [i].
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «y», alternation with e and the hielo exception (from memory).

findings.location: content.body.noteUk: "Перед i-/hi- змінюється на e."
findings.description: The unconditional letter-based rule incorrectly includes words such as hielo and hierba, before which y remains.
findings.suggestion: Replace with "Перед голосним звуком [i] змінюється на e: español e inglés. Перед [j] залишається y: agua y hielo."

items.reviewerAnswer: y = and; it becomes e before the vowel sound [i].
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «y», phonetic conditions for y/e (from memory).

findings.location: content.body.steps[id=s7].blocks[2].text: "Після них — інфінітив або іменник з артиклем"; steps[id=s11].blocks[0].items[0]: "e перед i-, hi-"
findings.description: The temporal explanation wrongly makes an article compulsory: antes de clase, después de clase and antes de mi clase are valid. The summary also replaces the sound-based y/e condition with an overbroad spelling rule.
findings.suggestion: Explain that a noun phrase or infinitive follows, with article use depending on the phrase. In the summary, specify e before the vowel sound [i].

items.reviewerAnswer: The lesson should teach addition, contrast, reasons, why-questions, polarity responses, nada/nadie, and temporal phrases with antes de/después de.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, treatment of article omission and temporal complements, including antes/después de clase (from memory).
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «y», alternation with e (from memory).

findings.location: task.errors[0].outcomes: "link.y/construction-use": "incorrect" for "Me gustan leer y cocinar."
findings.description: The answer uses y correctly. Its agreement error is attributed to the sole coordination target, although the feedback diagnoses gusta/gustan.
findings.suggestion: Separate the agreement diagnostic from the coordination outcome. Assess agreement under its own prerequisite-backed target if it is to affect mastery.

items.reviewerAnswer: Me gusta leer y cocinar. Also acceptable: Me gusta leer y me gusta cocinar.
sources: Course contract rule 1: assessment scope.
context.targets[0] and task.errors[0].feedbackUk: coordination is assessed, but agreement is diagnosed.

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: "Обери слово."; task.options[id=b] marks "y" incorrect in "Me gusta el té, ___ no me gusta el café."
findings.description: The prompt does not specify whether to express contrast or simply combine two facts. Both readings are reasonable; opposite polarity does not require pero.
findings.suggestion: Specify the intended relation, for example "Передай протиставлення словом «але».", or accept both a and b.

items.reviewerAnswer: a or b: pero expresses contrast; y can coordinate the two preferences.
sources: Course contract rule 2 and the verdict instruction for underdetermined readings.
RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 31, copulative and adversative coordination (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[1].text: "Quiero descansar, ___ tengo mucho trabajo."; task.options[id=a] marks "porque" incorrect.
findings.description: The workload can be an obstacle to resting or a reason for wanting rest. The prompt does not establish which relation is intended.
findings.suggestion: Add context establishing that work prevents the speaker from resting, or allow the causal reading.

items.reviewerAnswer: b for an obstacle to resting; a is also possible if the workload motivates the desire to rest.
sources: The packet's verdict instruction for underdetermined readings.
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, entries «pero» and «porque», adversative and causal meanings (from memory).

findings.location: task.accepted[id=v2].text: "No voy al cine porque estoy cansada."
findings.description: This transformation supplies "Estoy cansado." explicitly. The accepted variant changes its gender instead of merely joining the supplied sentences.
findings.suggestion: Remove v2, or explicitly permit adapting the speaker's gender in the instructions.

items.reviewerAnswer: No voy al cine porque estoy cansado.
sources: task.prompt[0] requests joining the supplied sentences; task.prompt[1] explicitly supplies "Estoy cansado."
Course contract rule 3: accepted answers must be acceptable for the stated task.

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: "Обери слово."; task.options[id=c] marks "y" incorrect in "No voy al cine ___ estoy cansado."
findings.description: Both a causal connection and simple coordination are natural. The prompt does not require the second clause to explain the first.
findings.suggestion: State that tiredness is the reason for not going, or accept both b and c.

items.reviewerAnswer: b or c: porque gives a reason; y simply adds the fact that the speaker is tired.
sources: Course contract rule 2 and the verdict instruction for underdetermined readings.
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, entries «y» and «porque», copulative and causal meanings (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[0].text: "друзів (vosotros)" requires os gusta; context.taughtBefore and task.hints do not establish prior teaching of os with gustar.

findings.location: task.hints[0].blocks[0].text and task.feedback.incorrectUk: "Після них — інфінітив або іменник з артиклем"; task.errors[0].feedbackUk: "Після de — інфінітив або іменник з артиклем"
findings.description: The explanation incorrectly makes an article obligatory with every noun after antes de/después de. Valid phrases include antes de clase and después de mi clase.
findings.suggestion: Say that these expressions take an infinitive or noun phrase, with article use depending on the phrase. Keep the correction from ceno to cenar.

items.reviewerAnswer: Después de cenar, leo. Also acceptable: Después de la cena, leo; Leo después de cenar.
items.notes: The listed accepted answers are correct.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, treatment of article omission and temporal complements with antes/después de (from memory).

findings.location: task.hints[0].blocks[0].text and task.feedback.incorrectUk: "іменник з артиклем"; task.slots[0].errors[text=de].feedbackUk: "Перед іменником потрібен артикль"
findings.description: Del trabajo is correct here, but the feedback turns this phrase-specific requirement into a false universal rule. Antes de/después de also occur with articleless nouns and possessive determiners.
findings.suggestion: Explain "У цьому реченні: después del trabajo; de + el = del." Replace the general article requirement with a context-dependent explanation.

items.reviewerAnswer: Después del trabajo voy al gimnasio.
items.notes: The slot's accepted value del is correct.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, article omission and temporal noun phrases (from memory).

findings.location: task.hints[0].blocks[0].text and task.feedback.incorrectUk: "Після них — інфінітив або іменник з артиклем"
findings.description: The explanation excludes the natural Spain Spanish phrase antes de clase by claiming that the noun must have an article.
findings.suggestion: Allow noun phrases with context-appropriate determiners or no article. Include antes de clase as a useful reviewed variant.

items.reviewerAnswer: Antes de clase tomo café. Also acceptable: Antes de la clase, tomo un café.
items.notes: The key is not closed; omission of antes de clase from accepted is not itself a demonstrated rejection.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, omission of the article in institutional expressions such as antes de clase (from memory).

findings.location: task.hints[0].blocks[0].text, task.feedback.incorrectUk and task.errors[0].feedbackUk: "інфінітив або іменник з артиклем"
findings.description: The explanation overgeneralizes article use. In addition, desayuno in the reviewed error can be read as a noun, so the feedback should distinguish a missing article in this phrase from use of a finite verb.
findings.suggestion: Explain the two repairs specifically: después de desayunar or después del desayuno. Remove the blanket requirement that every noun after these expressions take an article.

items.reviewerAnswer: Después de desayunar voy al trabajo. Also acceptable: Después del desayuno voy al trabajo.
items.notes: The accepted answers are correct.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, article use and omission in temporal noun phrases (from memory).
context.taughtBefore explicitly lists "desayuno — сніданок".

findings.location: task.hints[0].blocks[0].text, task.feedback.incorrectUk and task.errors[0].feedbackUk: "інфінітив або іменник з артиклем"
findings.description: The help falsely makes an article compulsory for noun complements. Before/after expressions also allow phrases such as antes de clase and después de mi clase.
findings.suggestion: Describe an infinitive or noun phrase, with article use determined by the particular phrase. Retain the valid correction of cenamos to cenar.

items.reviewerAnswer: Antes de cenar paseamos. Also acceptable: Antes de la cena paseamos.
items.notes: The accepted Spanish sentences are correct.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, article omission and temporal complements (from memory).

findings.location: task.hints[0].blocks[0].text and task.feedback.incorrectUk: "Після них — інфінітив або іменник з артиклем"
findings.description: The article requirement is false and directly conflicts with the valid completion después de clase.

items.reviewerAnswer: Después de clase voy a casa. Also acceptable: Después de la clase voy a casa.

sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, articleless institutional expressions such as después de clase (from memory).

findings.location: task.hints[0].blocks[0].text and task.feedback.incorrectUk: "Після них — інфінітив або іменник з артиклем"
findings.description: The help overgeneralizes from del trabajo to a compulsory article after all antes de/después de noun complements.

items.reviewerAnswer: Después del trabajo descanso. Also acceptable: Descanso después de trabajar.
